definition: a system where citizens elect their leaders
description: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

taps.phrase: to stand on a folding table
